_doc: Browser-interaction audit inventory. Every client-facing view x state x interactive element. The driver must touch 100% of inventoried ids and assert each element's declared expectations. `expects` holds machine-checked atoms from the vocabulary: nav (URL changes), fetch (recorder sees fetch:start/end), mut (recorder sees a mutation after the interaction), focus (activeElement moves), disable (button disabled + feedback label while submitting), value (typed value registers), toggle (open/closed state flips). `note` carries the human prose (what, why, nav target). The audit proves the INVENTORY was exercised — elements missing from the inventory are invisible to it, so review the inventory like code.
